newsitem.title: GERMANY: PreussenElektra seeks 10 pct of Swiss BKW.
newsitem.headline: PreussenElektra seeks 10 pct of Swiss BKW.

text.p: German utility PreussenElektra said on Tuesday that it plans to buy a 10 percent stake in Swiss energy group BKW FMB Energie AG after signing a cooperation pact with the Swiss firm on Friday.

The agreement centred on long-term cooperation in energy supply, but did not contain any concrete figures for the amount of energy to be supplied, a spokeswoman for PreussenElektra, a subsidiary of Veba AG, said.
The ongoing programme of liberalising the European energy market meant the two groups could share synergies, PreussenElektra said.
Bern-based BKW is one of six large energy suppliers in Switzerland, PreussenElektra said, supplying around a million inhabitants in five cantons.
